# Config

The commands `mt help` lists under Config. More in [The mt command line](../index.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`config-get`](#config-get) | Show the settings in effect and where each comes from (API URL, login, default namespace, interaction author, settings file) |

## config-get

Show the settings in effect and where each comes from (API URL, login, default namespace, interaction author, settings file).

```text
mt config-get
```

Doesn't need you to sign in.
